remarks: You've seen the rest, now see the best! Step into style at the coveted Clocktower Close! This beautifully updated and sophisticated unit blends modern finishes with timeless character, offering soaring ceilings, exposed brick, oversized windows, and rich wood floors filled with natural light. The stunning white kitchen is a true showstopper, featuring sleek cabinetry, tile floors, generous pantry storage, and a comfortable breakfast counter perfect for casual dining or entertaining. The inviting living room offers an airy loft-like feel, while a large storage closet and convenient powder room complete the main level. Upstairs, the open bedroom retreat boasts high ceilings, a spacious closet, and a beautifully designed full bath with a tub, radiant heating flooring, and smart built-in storage. Wall-unit heating and A/C provide year-round comfort, and laundry is conveniently located on every floor of the building. Residents enjoy exceptional amenities including a fitness center, community room, kitchen, and peaceful outdoor space to relax and unwind. Ideally located close to shopping, dining, Route 7, and the Merritt Parkway, this move-in ready gem offers the perfect combination of convenience, charm, and lifestyle. Bonus: radiant heated bathroom and kitchen floors! Don't miss your chance to own one of the most stylish units in the building!
